command: set -eu; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo HOME=$HOME; echo '--- candidate repos ---'; for d in "$HOME/frankenstein" "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/Frankenstein" "$HOME/.claude/plugins/frankenstein"; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo REPO=$d; git -C "$d" remote -v | head -4; git -C "$d" branch --show-current; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$d" status --short; fi; done; echo '--- discover matching git roots ---'; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | sed 's#/.git$##' | grep -Ei 'frankenstein|self-integration|clay-global-research-entity' | head -60
